mapper.select: select projId, max(insuranceEndDate) maxDate from (select a.id, a.policy_code policyCode, a.proj_id projId, b.proj_name projName, b.client_id clientId, a.insurance_start_date insuranceStartDate, a.insurance_end_date insuranceEndDate, a.insurance_company insuranceCompany, b.proj_sponsor_user_id projSponsorUserId, b.proj_cosponsor_user_ids projCosponsorUserIds, a.approval_status approvalStatus, 'policy' as dataSource, a.create_time createTime, a.update_time updateTime from policy_info a, proj_review_base_info b where a.proj_id = b.id and a.approval_status not in ("NEW_UNDER_APPROVAL", "CHANGING_UNDER_APPROVAL") union all select a.id, a.policy_code policyCode, b.id projId, b.proj_name projName, b.client_id clientId, a.insurance_start_date insuranceStartDate, a.insurance_end_date insuranceEndDate, a.insurance_company insuranceCompany, b.proj_sponsor_user_id projSponsorUserId, b.proj_cosponsor_user_ids projCosponsorUserIds, d.payment_process_status approvalStatus, 'payment' as dataSource, a.create_time createTime, d.update_time updateTime from payment_policy_info a, payment_base_info d, contract_base_info c, proj_review_base_info b where a.payment_id = d.id and d.contract_id = c.id and c.proj_review_id = b.id ) tmp group by projId having maxDate <= #{minTime}

select b.id projId,MAX(a.insurance_end_date) maxDate,d.payment_code from payment_policy_info a,payment_base_info d,contract_base_info c,proj_review_base_info b
a.payment_id = d.id and d.contract_id = c.id and c.proj_review_id = b.id
AND b.id IN
#{item}
group by b.id,d.payment_code

select a.policy + b.policy from (select count(1) policy from payment_policy_info p INNER JOIN payment_base_info b on p.payment_id = b.id where p.policy_code = #{policyCode} and b.payment_status != 'CLOSED') a, (select count(1) policy from policy_info where policy_code = #{policyCode}) b

select tmp.policy_code policy_code, count(1) codeNum from ( select a.policy_code from policy_info a where a.policy_code IN
#{item}
union ALL select b.policy_code from payment_policy_info b where b.policy_code IN
#{item} ) tmp GROUP BY tmp.policy_code
